summary.text: Mike Pellerito is a Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 36, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the September 8 Democratic primary.

paragraphs.text: Pellerito also ran in the Democratic primary for Hillsborough 32 in 2024, when he was one of three candidates who advanced to that year's general election.
